title: Liveness of run prefixes
statement: Let $k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $S$ be a state type, let $x$ be a binary string, let $M$ be a $k$-work-tape Turing machine over the binary alphabet with states in $S$, and let $c$ be a configuration on input $x$. If the machine has not halted after $t$ steps from $c$, then it has not halted after any $u\le t$ steps from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a $k$-work-tape machine over binary symbols with states in $S$
the machine has not halted at time $t$ from $c$
replaced:
If a multi-tape machine is live (not halted) after $t$ steps from a
configuration, then it is live after every earlier number of steps.
